news.title: DeKalb Police: Man shot by officer after holding woman and child at gunpoint, refusing commands to drop weapon
news.summary: The DeKalb County Police Department said the suspect involved was taken to a hospital with critical injuries.

news.title: Officers rammed in Gwinnett County incident, shoot at suspect vehicle
news.summary: The officers were described as in good condition following the incident.

news.title: Search underway for driver who rammed Gwinnett patrol car
news.summary: An officer opened fire on an SUV that rammed a patrol vehicle and nearly ran the officer over near an intersection off Rockbridge Road, according to Gwinnett County police.

news.title: 1 dead, 4 injured in Goliath ride incident at Six Flags Over Georgia; state launches investigation
news.summary: Officials confirmed to Channel 2 Cobb County Bureau Chief Michele Newell that one park visitor has died. Four others were injured.

news.title: Gwinnett police car rammed, suspect on the run after shots fired
news.summary: A large police investigation is underway near the DeKalb County-Gwinnett County line on Tuesday morning.

news.title: Six Flags Over Georgia death: Victim ejected from ride identified
news.summary: Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem, 42, of Atlanta, died following an ejection from a roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia.

news.title: Man holding woman and child hostage shot by DeKalb police
news.summary: An officer with the DeKalb County Police Department shot an armed suspect holding a woman and child hostage Tuesday morning near North Hairston Road, according to police.

news.title: Mackayla ‘Kash’ Paige, reality TV actress, fatally shot in Oakland
news.summary: The reality TV actress gained a following for her appearances on shows including “Young & Reckless,” “Roommhates” and “Now That’s Riot.”

news.title: Drone and drugs seized during Monroe County traffic stop
news.summary: Deputies arrested a Jonesboro man after finding a drone, marijuana, and ecstasy inside his vehicle during a traffic stop in Monroe County.

news.title: Pedestrian killed in DeKalb crash; other wrecks snarl traffic
news.summary: A pedestrian was killed in a crash on westbound Lavista Road at Henderson Road in DeKalb County early Tuesday morning.

news.title: McDonough man identified as suspect shot by deputies in Ashburn
news.summary: A 48-year-old McDonough man is in stable condition at a regional hospital after being shot by law enforcement following a chase in Turner County.

news.title: Car break-ins led Smyrna police to a wanted murder suspect
news.summary: Smyrna police captured 19-year-old Trey Webb last Thursday while responding to a report of car break-ins on Spring Road.

news.title: DNA testing solves 1997 missing woman case in Conyers
news.summary: The Conyers Police Department has positively identified human remains found in 2016 as Tammy Fortson, a woman who went missing nearly three decades ago.

news.title: Skeletal remains found in Conyers in 2016 identified as woman who went missing in 1997, police say
news.summary: The Conyers Police Department said Tammy Forston was positively identified by the GBI medical examiner in July of this year.

news.title: Bodycam shows 4 women arrested on I-85 after Newnan Target theft
news.summary: Four Alabama women face felony shoplifting charges after police said they stole $1,800 in merchandise from a Newnan Target.

news.title: Man found dead outside Tucker apartment building after reports of gunfire, police say
news.summary: Gwinnett County police are investigating after a man was found dead outside a Tucker apartment building following reports of gunfire.
